title: Giving Advice (Should / Ought to)
completion_message: ¡Muy bien! Dar consejos profesionales de manera educada es una habilidad clave en el entorno laboral.

parts.visual:
SHOULD (Debería): Es el modal más común para dar un consejo u opinión. 
Ej: You SHOULD talk to the manager (Deberías hablar con el gerente). 
You SHOULDN'T send that email (No deberías enviar ese correo).
parts.audio: Should is the most common modal verb for giving advice. For example: You should talk to the manager. Or in the negative: You shouldn't send that email.

parts.visual:
OUGHT TO (Debería): Significa exactamente lo mismo que 'Should', pero es un poco más formal. OJO: Siempre lleva 'to'. 
Ej: We OUGHT TO hire more staff (Deberíamos contratar más personal).
parts.audio: Ought to means exactly the same as should, but it is a little more formal. Remember, it always takes 'to'. For example: We ought to hire more staff.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la forma correcta para dar o pedir un consejo.

questions.question: You look very tired. You ____ take a break. (Deberías).
The deadline is tomorrow. We ____ to finish this tonight. (Deberíamos - formal).
questions.explanation: Como la oración ya tiene 'to' (to finish), la respuesta correcta es 'ought'.

questions.question: They ____ invest in that company. It's too risky. (No deberían).
What ____ I do about the angry client? (¿Qué debería hacer?).
questions.explanation: Para preguntas pidiendo consejo, usamos 'should' (What should I do?).

questions.question: You ____ to speak with human resources about this issue. (Deberías).
questions.explanation: Otra vez, el 'to' ya está en la frase, así que es 'ought' (ought to).

questions.question: I think we ____ delay the product launch. The software has bugs. (Deberíamos).
He ____ arrived late to the meeting again. (No debería haber). Wait! This is basic advice. He ____ arrive late. (No debería).
____ we accept their offer? (¿Deberíamos...?).
If you want a promotion, you ____ work harder. (Deberías).
We ____ to review the budget before the meeting. (Deberíamos).
You ____ open attachments from unknown senders. (No deberías).
I ____ complain to the manager, but I don't want problems. (Debería).
She ____ to apologize to the client. (Debería).
____ I wear a suit to the interview? (¿Debería...?).
questions.explanation: Should I wear a suit? (¿Debería usar traje?).

questions.question: The company ____ improve its customer service. (Debería).
They ____ hire someone with more experience. (Deberían).
We ____ to consider all the options before deciding. (Deberíamos).
You ____ be rude to the customers. (No deberías).
____ we call the supplier now? (¿Deberíamos...?).
I really think you ____ to take a few days off. (Deberías).
You ____ talk to him. (Deberías - modal más común)
You ____ to talk to him. (Deberías - formal)
We ____ invest in that. It's bad. (No deberíamos)
What ____ I do? (¿Qué debería yo...?)
They ____ to hire her. (Deberían - formal)
You ____ be late. (No deberías)
____ we accept? (¿Deberíamos...?)
She ____ to apologize. (Debería - formal)
You ____ work so hard. (No deberías)
I think you ____ ask for a raise. (Deberías)

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la frase que da un consejo.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: You should talk to the manager.
options: You should talk to the manager.
You shouldn't talk to the manager.
You ought to talk to the manager.
Should I talk to the manager?
questions.correct_answer: You should talk to the manager.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: We ought to hire more staff.
options: We ought to hire more staff.
They ought to hire more staff.
We ought to fire more staff.
questions.correct_answer: We ought to hire more staff.
